label: The Strongest Shield on the Surface: B

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: You truly do not know?

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: No. How the hell would I know?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: I suggest you think carefully once more. Do you truly know nothing of the sword-wielding human imposters?

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: You mean Scarlet, or whatever her name is?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: No, that's impossible. I would have recognized her.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Hell if I know. Go ask her yourself.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Well, fine. It's just one more human imposter anyway.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: That's big talk considering you both came crawling back here with your heads barely attached.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: ... It was merely a surprise attack. If we remain vigilant, it shall not occur again.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: Losing Marian is a major setback.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Indeed, it would have been most satisfying to take a full bite.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: That's not it. She should've been the Queen's next vessel, and we screwed it up.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Screwed it up? She bolted after getting just one slash. Speak properly, will you?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: ... Well, that matters little. There is ample time.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: The Queen above still appears to be in good health.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Haha, you mean the Queen who doesn't even bother to show her face?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: ... So, how does it feel to be back in the Queen's embrace,

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Nihilister?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: My, my, you were chattering away just a moment ago, and now you've gone unusually quiet.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Is it because you're barely more than a corpse?

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Shut your trap, you damn scorpion.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: And if I refuse? What can you possibly do?

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: I'll rip your jaw right off your face.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: I'm afraid I won't allow you to feast on Raptures. Not that you could, in that corpse-like state of yours.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: And neither I nor Chatterbox could be eaten. So you would be dead with a mere flick of my finger.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: So then, how do you plan to rip my mouth off?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: I know, I know. You don't want to be around Chatterbox and me after we made a meal of you.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: But you must understand: the Queen commanded us to act together. She wants Eden destroyed by our hands.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: So, let us cooperate. Do you understand?

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: You... I'll kill you if that's the last thing I do!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: I told you, it cannot be done. You insist regardless.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: While we remain under the Queen's command, we cannot fight among ourselves.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Besides... fighting corpses is hardly my pastime.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: ... Damn you!

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: Enough. Don't provoke her anymore.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Why not? It's fun.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: I get that, but we're about to go into battle. Now's not the time to sow doubt.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: There is no cause for concern, Chatterbox.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Under the Queen's rule, our will carries little weight.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Nihilister may speak boldly, yet she cannot strike us.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: The same goes for us

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: since we have been given orders.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Damn this control.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: So, whatever grievances or grudges we may have with one another, let's try to get along, shall we?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Now then, would you mind fetching me a glass of water?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: We ought to cooperate, don't you think?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Since we'll be the ones doing all the hard fighting, you—who can't do anything—should at least try to be helpful.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: There is one thing I truly wonder.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Why did you bring us out of the Ark?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Surely it was not for some ulterior motive that required comrades.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Perhaps you merely desired a special treat? How ironic that you have become the treat yourself.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Surely that can't be true? You needed comrades?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Heh, hehe... Ahahaha...

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Nihilister, Nihilister, you foolish fire dragon.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: There's no way something like that could exist between us.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: We are all merely...
Indivilia looks up at the sky.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: scraps of that thing.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... How's Noah doing?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: She overused her core's power, causing it to overheat.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... The core was destroyed, and even her body was scorched.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Is her brain... intact?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... We moved it to a brain shelter.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Th-that's a relief.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: She can be revived as long as she gets a new body, right?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Her brain overheated too, so this might be hard.
*Zing*

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: All of you, get ready. The battle is about to begin.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Johan.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Never mind. It's nothing.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: All of you, move out.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Roger that.
*Zing*
Rapunzel and Papillon leave the infirmary.
Johan looks back and forth between Noah's half-burned body
and the brain shelter across from him.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... *Sigh*

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I don't even know where I should start patting her.
Johan raises both hands, resting one on the body's head
and the other on the brain shelter.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: You followed my orders well and acted on your own judgment.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Thanks to you, Eden didn't take so much as a scratch, and repairs on Eden's Spear are progressing smoothly.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The Monk and the Spy made it out alive, too.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I will have my revenge

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: on that arrogant thing watching us from above.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I'll bring it down.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Mark my words.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Good work.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... This place is...?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Eden it is, Young Lady Marian.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Eden...

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I go by Nayuta, the fourth member of the Forerunner.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... Like Snow White, Scarlet, and Rapunzel...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: So it is. They are all here...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: assembled to vanquish the Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Their purpose is as thine own, Young Lady Marian.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Young Lady Marian.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Though this be our first acquaintance, I would fain proffer unto thee some counsel.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should any inquisitive soul inquire how thou camest hither unaccompanied, or why the Maiden of Thunder struck thee down,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: be steadfast in declaring it naught but mere happenstance.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Or else, reveal thy true name and purpose. 'Twere most prudent to pursue but one of these courses.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... Do you know what I am?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, I am aware.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Who do you think I am?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Queen.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Please keep it a secret. I beg you.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should that be thy choice, I shall honor it forthwith.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yet, in sooth,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: given the present state of affairs, information doth overflow.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should they hear from the enemy's mouth who thou art,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: the chaos that ensueth may prove most dire.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: If I tell them what I am,

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: do you really think they would just leave me be?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: These are people who have spent years roaming the surface to kill the Queen.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I don't believe that spending a little time together would weaken their purpose.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I have known the Forerunners but a short while, and my sojourn in Eden has been yet briefer.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yet I do, verily, pride myself on mine own discerning eye for people.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Your eyes are closed, you know.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Verily, does this suffice?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: You have beautiful eyes.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Pray, let us return to the matter at hand.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Dost thou think that they would lose all reason and seek to take thy life if they knew thee to be the Queen?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Surely thou knowest the answer.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... I... can't say for sure.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Very well. Then I shall grant thee a promise:

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: should either the Forerunners or Eden lay gun or blade upon thee,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I shall defend thee, even at the cost of mine own life.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... But we've only just met.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Did I not speak unto thee? Mine eye for people is most discerning.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thou art... aye,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I have no doubt that thou art one who holdeth the fate of this realm with thine hands.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: And at once, one destined to bring forth true peace. Verily, I doubt it not.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: And prithee, keep this a secret:

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I do possess thousands of lives. Thus, I shall protect you countless times over.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Pfft.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Hohoho, verily, this is no jest.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Pray, ponder it well.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Would it not be a thing most splendid?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: What would?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: To stand before all,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: and proclaim

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: thyself the Queen of the Raptures.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I shall take my leave now.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thy wounds shall mend in due time, so come forth at thy leisure.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Uh... Nayuta?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Do tell.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... Thank you.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Hoho.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Behold. Did I not say mine eyes are keen?

lines.speaker: isabel_op_l
lines.text: Harran. Noah has—

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I heard.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: She put up quite a fight. Quite well, too.

lines.speaker: isabel_op_r
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: There is neither time to grieve nor wallow in sorrow.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: You know full well that should you surrender to such feelings now, death will swiftly claim you.

lines.speaker: isabel_op_r
lines.text: Yeah, I know.

lines.speaker: isabel_op_r
lines.text: I just wanted to tell her how amazing she was.

lines.speaker: isabel_op_r
lines.text: It looked even better from up in the air.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Is that so? That must have been quite the spectacle.

lines.speaker: isabel_op_r
lines.text: Yeah, it really was magnificent.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Haha, she truly proved herself as the strongest shield that she could've hoped for.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: ... How admirable.

lines.speaker: isabel_op_r
lines.text: Exactly. It was impressive.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Then I shall take my leave.

lines.speaker: isabel_op_r
lines.text: Yeah, take care.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: You too.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Don't just stand there.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Oh, forgive me.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: ... Snow White, have you ever lost a comrade?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Many times.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: So time really healed it?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I fought on despite the pain.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Heh, not so easy, huh?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Be strong.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I plan to.
Harran swings her scythe at the Raptures.
